title: Magnetic Beads Cell Separation
author: Laura Sánchez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8schwaw

steps.title: Prepare Magnetic Module
steps.instruction: Remove the magnetic plate and load the required number of 1.5-mL microcentrifuge tubes into the magnetic module.

steps.title: Prepare E. coli Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare fresh cultured E. coli samples in PBS with a cell concentration of 10^6 CFU/mL.

substeps.instruction: Measure the optical density of the bacterial inoculum at 600 nm absorbance (OD 600).
Dilute the inoculum to the correct concentration using the relation: 1 OD = 1E9 CFU/mL.
Collect sample C o.

steps.title: Bind Bacteria to Magnetic Beads
steps.instruction: Combine the bacterial samples with MagneHis™ beads and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of each sample to a new Eppendorf tube.
Add 300 μL of MagneHis™ to the bacteria mixture.
Resuspend cells properly by gentle mixing.
Incubate at room temperature for 30, 45, and 60 min each under gentle continuous agitation to prevent beads from settling.

steps.title: Separate Magnetic Complex
steps.instruction: Isolate the bead-cell complexes using the magnetic module.

substeps.instruction: Insert the magnetic plate into the magnetic module.
Allow the tube to stand for 3 min for maximum recovery.
Carefully remove the supernatant with a pipette and place it in a new tube; collect as sample C nb.

steps.title: Wash Magnetic Beads
steps.instruction: Wash the captured cells to remove unbound bacteria.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of Wash Buffer (or PBS) and resuspend by inversion.
Allow the tube to stand in the magnetic module for 3 min.
Repeat the washing process twice more, collecting supernatants as sample C w1 and C w2.

steps.title: Elute Bacteria from Beads
steps.instruction: Release the bacteria from the MagneHis™ complex using Elution Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the MagneHis™ complex in 100 μL of Elution Buffer.
Mix briefly by inversion.
Allow the tube to stand in the magnetic module for 1.5 min.
Carefully collect the supernatant and add it to a 900 μL LB Eppendorf; collect as sample C f.

steps.title: Recover Beads
steps.instruction: Resuspend the beads in 100 μL LB and collect as sample C ne.

steps.title: Quantify Bacteria via Spread Plating
steps.instruction: Determine the CFU/mL through serial dilution and plating.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 10-fold dilution series up to 10^-7.
Plate 100 μL from dilutions 10^-1, 10^-2, and 10^-3 onto three different agar plates containing the pertinent antibiotic.
Incubate plates at 37°C for 48 h.
Enumerate colonies and express the result as CFU/mL.
